outcome: complications within 1 year of postpartum hemorrhage diagnosis
psychiatric sequelae within 7 days of postpartum hemorrhage diagnosis
cohort: 10,649 postpartum females who were billed for either a vaginal or cesarean delivery
finding: Having a mental health disorder history is associated with higher odds of developing complications within 1 year of postpartum hemorrhage diagnosis.
mod_finding: The study differentiated between vaginal and cesarean deliveries but did not report findings related to mode of delivery.
